title: Your Phone vs the Moon Landing

scenes.text: The phone in your pocket is millions of times more powerful than the computer that landed on the Moon.
The Apollo guidance computer ran at about one megahertz, with less memory than a single photo takes today.
Yet it flew people a million kilometers round trip, because the software was tested like lives depended on it. They did.
Meanwhile your phone spends that power on cat videos. Technology grows, priorities differ.
